sections.h2: 95 of 372 notified SEZs were not operating on 31 July 2026

chart.title: A quarter of notified zones were idle, while 277 were operating
chart.source: Lok Sabha written reply, as reported.

sections.means: Of 372 notified zones, 95 were not operating on 31 July 2026, according to the ministry's reply.
sections.todo: Publish the SEZ 2.0 report, which has not appeared, so the idle zones can be addressed under a stated policy.

sections.h2: Haryana has the most idle zones, 14, followed by Telangana with 12

chart.title: Haryana, Telangana and Karnataka have the most idle notified zones
chart.sub: Notified SEZs not operating, by state, 31 July 2026.
chart.source: Lok Sabha written reply, as reported.

sections.means: Haryana led the idle zones with 14, ahead of Telangana with 12, Karnataka with 11, and Tamil Nadu and Uttar Pradesh with 9 each.
sections.todo: State governments with idle zones should report the approval delays the ministry cited, since slow statutory approvals were one of its reasons.

sections.h2: SEZ exports rose to Rs 16.4 lakh crore in 2025-26 from Rs 14.63 lakh crore

chart.title: Full-year SEZ exports rose in 2025-26 even as idle zones remained
chart.sub: Exports from SEZs, Rs lakh crore, full years only.

sections.means: Full-year SEZ exports rose from Rs 14.63 lakh crore in 2024-25 to Rs 16.40 lakh crore in 2025-26.
sections.todo: Compare full-year export figures from the same source before drawing conclusions, since the April–December releases measure nine months.
